Monitors only the account bound when enabled. To change it, disable, switch accounts and enable again. Includes muted and archived chats. No history scanning or extra background service. System notification permissions and channel settings apply.

Nullgram is independently modified from Niagram (formerly NiagramX), 13.1.1 (1311), revision c819d178d0fed124117558054cddbf64dc746cfa. It is not an official release of Niagram, NagramX, Nagram, Nekogram or Telegram. Copyright and third-party notices are preserved. Source is licensed under GPLv3; matching complete source and build instructions accompany the APK distribution. The application ID is retained for compatibility; the Nullgram display name identifies this independent fork; launcher artwork retains its original attribution, with optional independent Nullgram icons.
Nullgram is a Telegram client mod.
New media message. Tap to view.
Add up to 100 people. Duplicate entries and your own account are not allowed.

The watchlist belongs to this page’s account. New options are off by default. People are identified by user ID, never by names, channel signatures or forwarded authors. Channel comments count as group messages. Channel posts need an explicit personal sender ID. Online alerts use visible status only, skip initial/reconnect baselines and have a 60-second cooldown. Privacy, network and background restrictions can cause missed alerts.
Clear all watched person events for this account?

The most recent 200 watched person events are stored on this device. Tap a record to open the chat or message. Banners appear when this account is open in the app. System notifications are used when the banner is unavailable.

Search local names and avatar overrides for this account. Tap to open a chat; hold to edit or restore its name or avatar separately. Use this page for private aliases; ordinary Telegram search may send queries to the server.
This chat is not available locally. You can still hold its alias to restore the original name.
Move previous aliases to this account
Previous aliases did not belong to a specific account. Move them to the current account? Existing aliases in this account take priority.
Name and avatar are saved independently on this device. Changes are not uploaded. Tap Save to apply, or go back to cancel.

This status shows this device’s connection. Who can see you online is controlled by Telegram privacy settings.
A theme applies the selected parts together. Individual changes are available with the original appearance and after applying a theme.

Home appearance covers Messages, Contacts, Calls and Me. QQ conversation styling mainly supports regular private and group chats. The top-left title changes app headings; account-style headers still show your nickname.
The custom Home screen shortcut uses the current icon and top-left title. The original launcher entry uses its icon preset name, which may differ from a custom title.
Names and avatars are local to the current account. Changing a theme or restoring appearance keeps them.
Restore the original icon, top-left title, home and conversation appearance. Keep local names, avatars, chat backgrounds and other settings.
Manage local names and avatars for this account. Use the plus button to add, tap to edit, or hold to open a chat or restore its name or avatar. Search stays on this device.
